d: Jet black hair is styled in long high twin-tails with straight bangs and side-locks, adorned with large white, pink, and teal bows. The eyes are a vibrant cornflower blue with a joyful, wide expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build is dressed in a gothic-lolita outfit consisting of a white ruffled blouse, a black corset, and a large pink and black striped bow at the chest, accented by white frilled sleeves. Signature details include a thin black eyepatch over the left eye and a black choker with a golden bell.
